newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro traders now put Iran wheat deal at 300,000 T.
newsitem.headline: Euro traders now put Iran wheat deal at 300,000 T.

text.p: Iran last week bought 300,000 tonnes of European Union soft wheat, mostly French, for shipment in April, European grain traders said on Monday.
Several exporters cited an average selling price of around $140 per tonne, fob.
There was still no official confirmation of the deal.
Most of the wheat was French but sellers have the option to cover part of the contract with wheat from other suppliers in the European Union, they said.
Last week grain traders said Iran had bought between 200,000 and 400,000 tonnes of French wheat at prices ranging from $139 to $144 per tonne, fob.
